name: bootci
expr: ci = bootci(1000, @mean, x); contains_mean = double(ci(1) <= m && m <= ci(2)); width = ci(2) - ci(1);
comment: Sig: ci = bootci(nboot, fn, X[, alpha]). Percentile bootstrap CI. NOT bit-identical with MATLAB (std::uniform_int_distribution implementation-defined; randn also not bit-identical). Statistical correctness verified: 95% CI contains true mean.
